items.source: Note:This flag only applies to an explicit rollback attempt for a subtransaction, typically caused by an exception thrown by a data access operation (where TransactionInterceptor will trigger a PlatformTransactionManager.rollback() call according to a rollback rule). If the flag is off, the caller can handle the exception and decide on a rollback, independent of the rollback rules of the subtransaction. This flag does, however, not apply to explicit setRollbackOnly calls on a TransactionStatus, which will always cause an eventual global rollback (as it might not throw an exception after the rollback-only call).
items.translation: 注意：此标志仅适用于子事务的显式回滚尝试，通常由数据访问操作抛出的异常引起（此时 TransactionInterceptor 将根据回滚规则触发PlatformTransactionManager.rollback()调用）。如果该标志关闭，调用者可以处理异常并决定是否回滚，而独立于子事务的回滚规则。然而，此标志不适用于对TransactionStatus的显式setRollbackOnly调用，这些调用将始终导致最终的全局回滚（因为在设置回滚-only 后可能不会抛出异常）。

items.source: Subclasses can override this to return false, causing a further call to doBegin - within the context of an already existing transaction. The doBegin implementation needs to handle this accordingly in such a scenario. This is appropriate for JTA, for example.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法以返回 `false`，从而在已存在的事务上下文中进一步调用 `doBegin`。在这种情况下，`doBegin` 的实现需要相应地处理。例如，这对于 JTA 是合适的。

items.source: Override this to return "true" if the concrete transaction manager expects a doCommit call even for a rollback-only transaction, allowing for special handling there. This will, for example, be the case for JTA, where UserTransaction.commit will check the read-only flag itself and throw a corresponding RollbackException, which might include the specific reason (such as a transaction timeout).
items.translation: 覆盖此方法，以便在具体的事务管理器即使对于仅回滚的事务也期望调用doCommit时返回"true"，从而允许对此进行特殊处理。例如，对于 JTA 而言，UserTransaction.commit 将自行检查只读标志并抛出相应的 RollbackException，该异常可能包含具体原因（如事务超时）。

items.source: Default is the underlying transaction infrastructure's default timeout, for example, typically 30 seconds in case of a JTA provider, indicated by the TransactionDefinition.TIMEOUT_DEFAULT value.
items.translation: 默认值为底层事务基础设施的默认超时时间，例如在 JTA 提供者的情况下通常为 30 秒，由 `TransactionDefinition.TIMEOUT_DEFAULT` 值指示。

items.source: Returns TransactionDefinition.TIMEOUT_DEFAULT to indicate the underlying transaction infrastructure's default timeout.
items.translation: 返回TransactionDefinition.TIMEOUT_DEFAULT，以指示底层事务基础设施的默认超时时间。

items.source: Default is "true": If a participating transaction (for example, with PROPAGATION_REQUIRED or PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS encountering an existing transaction) fails, the transaction will be globally marked as rollback-only. The only possible outcome of such a transaction is a rollback: The transaction originator cannot make the transaction commit anymore.
items.translation: 默认为"true"：如果参与的事务（例如，遇到现有事务的 PROPAGATION_REQUIRED 或 PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS）失败，该事务将被全局标记为仅回滚。此类事务的唯一可能结果就是回滚：事务发起者无法再提交该事务。

items.source: To be called by this abstract manager itself, or by special implementations of the registerAfterCompletionWithExistingTransaction callback.
items.translation: 由该抽象管理器本身调用，或由registerAfterCompletionWithExistingTransaction回调的特殊实现调用。

items.source: Default is true, which causes delegation to DefaultTransactionStatus for creating and holding a savepoint. If the transaction object does not implement the SavepointManager interface, a NestedTransactionNotSupportedException will be thrown. Else, the SavepointManager will be asked to create a new savepoint to demarcate the start of the nested transaction.
items.translation: 默认为 `true`，这将导致委托给 DefaultTransactionStatus 以创建和保存保存点。如果事务对象未实现 SavepointManager 接口，将抛出 NestedTransactionNotSupportedException 异常。否则，将请求 SavepointManager 创建一个新的保存点，以界定嵌套事务的开始。

items.source: If this method returns "true" but the doCommit implementation does not throw an exception, this transaction manager will throw an UnexpectedRollbackException itself. This should not be the typical case; it is mainly checked to cover misbehaving JTA providers that silently roll back even when the rollback has not been requested by the calling code.
items.translation: 如果此方法返回 "true"，但 `doCommit` 实现未抛出异常，则此事务管理器本身将抛出 `UnexpectedRollbackException`。这不应是典型情况；主要检查此情况是为了涵盖行为不当的 JTA 提供者，这些提供者在调用代码未请求回滚的情况下静默回滚。

items.source:
Transaction synchronization is a generic mechanism for registering callbacks
that get invoked at transaction completion time. This is mainly used internally
by the data access support classes for JDBC, Hibernate, JPA, etc when running
within a JTA transaction: They register resources that are opened within the
transaction for closing at transaction completion time, allowing, for example, for reuse
of the same Hibernate Session within the transaction. The same mechanism can
also be leveraged for custom synchronization needs in an application.
items.translation: 事务同步是一种通用机制，用于注册在事务完成时调用的回调。这主要被数据访问支持类（如 JDBC、Hibernate、JPA 等）在 JTA 事务内部运行时使用：它们注册在事务期间打开的资源，以便在事务完成时关闭，从而允许例如在同一事务中重用同一个 Hibernate Session。该机制也可用于应用程序中的自定义同步需求。

items.source:
Note that transaction synchronization isn't supported for
multiple concurrent transactions by different transaction managers.
Only one transaction manager is allowed to activate it at any time.
items.translation: 请注意，事务同步不支持由不同事务管理器管理的多个并发事务。在任何时候，只允许一个事务管理器激活它。

items.source:
Typically initialized with an appropriate default by the
concrete transaction manager subclass.
items.translation: 通常由具体的事务管理器子类初始化为适当的默认值。

items.source:
When participating in an existing transaction (for example, with
PROPAGATION_REQUIRED or PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS encountering an existing
transaction), this outer transaction's characteristics will apply even
to the inner transaction scope. Validation will detect incompatible
isolation level and read-only settings on the inner transaction definition
and reject participation accordingly through throwing a corresponding exception.
items.translation: 当参与现有事务（例如，在遇到现有事务时遇到 PROPAGATION_REQUIRED 或 PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS）时，该外部事务的特性将适用于内部事务范围。验证将检测内部事务定义中不兼容的隔离级别和只读设置，并通过抛出相应的异常来拒绝参与。

items.source:
Default is "false", leniently ignoring inner transaction settings,
simply overriding them with the outer transaction's characteristics.
Switch this flag to "true" in order to enforce strict validation.
items.translation: 默认为 "false"，宽松地忽略内部事务设置，仅用外部事务的特性覆盖它们。将此标志切换为 "true" 以强制执行严格验证。

items.source:
Switch this to "false" to let the transaction originator make the rollback
decision. If a participating transaction fails with an exception, the caller
can still decide to continue with a different path within the transaction.
However, note that this will only work as long as all participating resources
are capable of continuing towards a transaction commit even after a data access
failure: This is generally not the case for a Hibernate Session, for example;
neither is it for a sequence of JDBC insert/update/delete operations.
items.translation: 将其切换为 "false" 以允许事务发起方做出回滚决定。如果参与的事务因异常而失败，调用方仍可以决定在事务内继续执行不同的路径。然而，请注意，这仅在所有参与的资源在数据访问失败后仍能继续向事务提交推进时才有效：例如，Hibernate Session 通常不具备此能力；JDBC 的插入/更新/删除操作序列也是如此。

items.source:
The recommended solution for handling failure of a subtransaction
is a "nested transaction", where the global transaction can be rolled
back to a savepoint taken at the beginning of the subtransaction.
PROPAGATION_NESTED provides exactly those semantics; however, it will
only work when nested transaction support is available. This is the case
with DataSourceTransactionManager, but not with JtaTransactionManager.
items.translation: 处理子事务失败的推荐解决方案是“嵌套事务”，其中全局事务可以回滚到子事务开始时设置的保存点。`PROPAGATION_NESTED` 提供了这些语义；然而，它仅在支持嵌套事务时才能工作。`DataSourceTransactionManager` 支持此功能，但 `JtaTransactionManager` 不支持。

items.source:
Default is "false", only causing an UnexpectedRollbackException at the
outermost transaction boundary. Switch this flag on to cause an
UnexpectedRollbackException as early as the global rollback-only marker
has been first detected, even from within an inner transaction boundary.
items.translation: 默认为"false"，仅在最外层事务边界处引发 UnexpectedRollbackException。将此标志设置为 true 后，一旦检测到全局回滚标记，即使在内部事务边界内，也会尽早引发 UnexpectedRollbackException。

items.source:
Note that the fail-early behavior for global
rollback-only markers has been unified: All transaction managers will by
default only cause UnexpectedRollbackException at the outermost transaction
boundary. This allows, for example, to continue unit tests even after an
operation failed and the transaction will never be completed. All transaction
managers will only fail earlier if this flag has explicitly been set to "true".
items.translation: 请注意，全局 `rollback-only` 标记的提前失败行为已统一：所有事务管理器默认仅在最外层事务边界处抛出 `UnexpectedRollbackException`。例如，即使操作失败且事务将永远不会完成，也可以继续执行单元测试。仅当此标志被显式设置为 "true" 时，所有事务管理器才会更早地失败。

items.source:
The default implementation throws a TransactionSuspensionNotSupportedException,
assuming that transaction suspension is generally not supported.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出 `TransactionSuspensionNotSupportedException`，假定事务挂起通常不受支持。

items.source:
Does not apply if an application locally sets the transaction to rollback-only
via the TransactionStatus, but only to the transaction itself being marked as
rollback-only by the transaction coordinator.
items.translation: 如果应用程序通过 `TransactionStatus` 在本地将事务设置为仅回滚，则此规则不适用；但仅当事务协调器将事务本身标记为仅回滚时除外。

items.source:
Default is "false": Local transaction strategies usually don't hold the rollback-only
marker in the transaction itself, therefore they can't handle rollback-only transactions
as part of transaction commit. Hence, AbstractPlatformTransactionManager will trigger
a rollback in that case, throwing an UnexpectedRollbackException afterwards.
items.translation: 默认为 "false"：本地事务策略通常不会在事务本身中保留回滚标记，因此它们无法将回滚仅事务作为事务提交的一部分进行处理。因此，AbstractPlatformTransactionManager 在这种情况下会触发回滚，随后抛出 UnexpectedRollbackException。

items.source: Return whether doRollback should be performed on failure of the doCommit call.
items.translation: 返回在doCommit调用失败时是否应执行doRollback。

items.source: This implementation of rollback handles participating in existing transactions. Delegates to doRollback and doSetRollbackOnly.
items.translation: 此回滚实现处理参与现有事务。委托给 `doRollback` 和 `doSetRollbackOnly`。

items.source: Set the transaction synchronization by the name of the corresponding constant in this class — for example, "SYNCHRONIZATION_ALWAYS".
items.translation: 通过此类的相应常量的名称设置事务同步——例如，"SYNCHRONIZATION_ALWAYS"。

items.source: Suspend the given transaction. Suspends transaction synchronization first, then delegates to the doSuspend template method.
items.translation: 挂起给定的事务。首先挂起事务同步，然后委托给 `doSuspend` 模板方法。

items.source: Resume the given transaction. Delegates to the doResume template method first, then resuming transaction synchronization.
items.translation: 恢复给定的事务。首先委托调用 doResume 模板方法，然后恢复事务同步。

items.source:
Always activate transaction synchronization, even for "empty" transactions
that result from PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS with no existing backend transaction.
items.translation: 始终激活事务同步，即使对于由 PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS 且不存在后端事务而导致的“空”事务也是如此。

items.source: Never active transaction synchronization, not even for actual transactions.
items.translation: 永不激活事务同步，即使对于实际的事务也是如此。

items.source:
Activate transaction synchronization only for actual transactions,
that is, not for empty ones that result from PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS with
no existing backend transaction.
items.translation: 仅针对实际事务激活事务同步，即不包括由 PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS 且无现有后端事务导致的空事务。

items.source: Return the registered transaction execution listeners for this transaction manager.
items.translation: 返回此事务管理器已注册的执行监听器。

items.source:
Return if this transaction manager should activate the thread-bound
transaction synchronization support.
items.translation: 如果该事务管理器应激活线程绑定的事务同步支持，则返回。

items.source:
Return whether to fail early in case of the transaction being globally marked
as rollback-only.
items.translation: 返回在事务被全局标记为仅回滚时是否应提前失败。

items.source:
Return whether to globally mark an existing transaction as rollback-only
after a participating transaction failed.
items.translation: 在参与的事务失败后，返回是否将现有事务全局标记为仅回滚。

items.source: Return whether nested transactions are allowed.
items.translation: 返回是否允许嵌套事务。

items.source:
Return whether existing transactions should be validated before participating
in them.
items.translation: 返回在参与现有事务之前是否应验证这些事务。

items.source: Initialize transaction synchronization as appropriate.
items.translation: 根据需要初始化事务同步。

items.source:
Set the transaction execution listeners for begin/commit/rollback callbacks
from this transaction manager.
items.translation: 从此事务管理器设置用于开始/提交/回滚回调的事务执行监听器。

items.translation: status - 由 getTransaction 方法返回的对象

items.translation: TransactionSuspensionNotSupportedException - 如果事务管理器实现不支持恢复

items.translation: TransactionException - 在提交或系统错误的情况下

items.source: an object that holds suspended resources (or null if neither transaction nor synchronization active)
items.translation: 一个持有挂起资源的对象（或者如果既没有事务也没有同步活动，则为null）

items.translation: <synchronizations></synchronizations> - 一个 TransactionSynchronization 对象的列表

items.translation: completionStatus - 根据 TransactionSynchronization 接口中的常量确定的完成状态

items.source:
triggers registered synchronization callbacks
(if transaction synchronization is active).
items.translation: 注册的触发器会调用同步回调（如果事务同步处于活动状态）。

items.source: The state of this class is serializable, to allow for serializing the transaction strategy along with proxies that carry a transaction interceptor. It is up to subclasses if they wish to make their state to be serializable too. They should implement the java.io.Serializable marker interface in that case, and potentially a private readObject() method (according to Java serialization rules) if they need to restore any transient state.
items.translation: 该类的状态是可序列化的，以便能够连同携带事务拦截器的代理一起序列化事务策略。子类可根据需要自行决定是否使其状态也可序列化。如果是这样，它们应实现 `java.io.Serializable` 标记接口，并且如果需要恢复任何瞬态状态，则可能需要根据 Java 序列化规则实现一个私有的 `readObject()` 方法。

items.source: The returned object should contain information about any existing transaction, that is, a transaction that has already started before the current getTransaction call on the transaction manager. Consequently, a doGetTransaction implementation will usually look for an existing transaction and store corresponding state in the returned transaction object.
items.translation: 返回的对象应包含有关任何现有事务的信息，即在当前对事务管理器的 `getTransaction` 调用之前已经启动的事务。因此，`doGetTransaction` 的实现通常会查找现有事务，并将相应的状态存储在返回的事务对象中。

items.source: Called after doCommit and doRollback execution, on any outcome. The default implementation does nothing.
items.translation: 在 `doCommit` 和 `doRollback` 执行后，无论结果如何都会调用。默认实现什么都不做。

items.source: The default implementation returns false, assuming that participating in existing transactions is generally not supported. Subclasses are of course encouraged to provide such support.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 `false`，假设通常不支持参与现有事务。当然鼓励子类提供此类支持。

items.source: A special scenario is a nested transaction without savepoint: If useSavepointForNestedTransaction() returns "false", this method will be called to start a nested transaction when necessary. In such a context, there will be an active transaction: The implementation of this method has to detect this and start an appropriate nested transaction.
items.translation: 特殊场景是指不带保存点的嵌套事务：如果useSavepointForNestedTransaction()返回"false"，则会在必要时调用此方法以启动嵌套事务。在此类上下文中，将存在一个活动事务：此方法的实现必须检测这一点并启动适当的嵌套事务。

items.source: The default implementation simply invokes the afterCompletion methods immediately, passing in "STATUS_UNKNOWN". This is the best we can do if there's no chance to determine the actual outcome of the outer transaction.
items.translation: 默认实现会立即调用afterCompletion方法，并传入"STATUS_UNKNOWN"。如果无法确定外部事务的实际结果，这是我们能做的最好的了。

items.source: This base class provides the following workflow handling:
items.translation: 该基类提供以下工作流处理：

items.source:
Subclasses have to implement specific template methods for specific
states of a transaction, for example: begin, suspend, resume, commit, rollback.
The most important of them are abstract and must be provided by a concrete
implementation; for the rest, defaults are provided, so overriding is optional.
items.translation: 子类必须为事务的特定状态（例如：begin、suspend、resume、commit、rollback）实现特定的模板方法。其中最重要的是抽象方法，必须由具体实现提供；其余方法提供了默认实现，因此重写是可选的。

items.source: Default is "false".
items.translation: 默认值为"false"。

items.source:
The returned object will usually be specific to the concrete transaction
manager implementation, carrying corresponding transaction state in a
modifiable fashion. This object will be passed into the other template
methods (for example, doBegin and doCommit), either directly or as part of a
DefaultTransactionStatus instance.
items.translation: 返回的对象通常针对具体的事务管理器实现，以可修改的方式承载相应的事务状态。该对象将直接作为参数传入其他模板方法（例如 doBegin 和 doCommit），或者作为 DefaultTransactionStatus 实例的一部分传入。

items.source:
The result will be evaluated according to the specified propagation
behavior for the new transaction. An existing transaction might get
suspended (in case of PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW), or the new transaction
might participate in the existing one (in case of PROPAGATION_REQUIRED).
items.translation: 结果将根据新事务指定的传播行为进行评估。现有事务可能会被挂起（在 PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW 的情况下），或者新事务可能会参与现有事务（在 PROPAGATION_REQUIRED 的情况下）。

items.source:
This method gets called when the transaction manager has decided to actually
start a new transaction. Either there wasn't any transaction before, or the
previous transaction has been suspended.
items.translation: 此方法在事务管理器决定实际开始一个新事务时被调用。要么之前没有事务，要么之前的交易已被挂起。

items.source:
Note that exceptions will get propagated to the commit caller
and cause a rollback of the transaction.
items.translation: 注意，异常将传播到提交调用者并导致事务回滚。

items.source:
An implementation does not need to check the "new transaction" flag
or the rollback-only flag; this will already have been handled before.
Usually, a straight commit will be performed on the transaction object
contained in the passed-in status.
items.translation: 实现无需检查“新事务”标志或回滚专用标志；这些在此之前已经处理过。通常，将在传入状态中包含的事务对象上执行直接提交。
实现无需检查“新事务”标志；该标志此前已处理。通常，将对传入状态中包含的事务对象执行直接回滚。

items.source:
The default implementation throws an IllegalTransactionStateException,
assuming that participating in existing transactions is generally not
supported. Subclasses are of course encouraged to provide such support.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出 `IllegalTransactionStateException`，假定参与现有事务通常不受支持。当然，鼓励子类提供此类支持。

items.source:
Invoked when the control of the Spring transaction manager and thus all Spring
transaction synchronizations end, without the transaction being completed yet. This
is for example the case when participating in an existing JTA or EJB CMT transaction.
items.translation: 在 Spring 事务管理器以及所有 Spring 事务同步结束但事务尚未完成时被调用。例如，当参与现有的 JTA 或 EJB CMT 事务时就会出现这种情况。

items.source: Should not throw any exceptions but just issue warnings on errors.

items.source: This implementation handles propagation behavior. Delegates to doGetTransaction, isExistingTransaction and doBegin.
items.translation: 此实现处理传播行为。委托给`doGetTransaction`、`isExistingTransaction`和`doBegin`。

items.source: This implementation of commit handles participating in existing transactions and programmatic rollback requests. Delegates to isRollbackOnly, doCommit and rollback.
items.translation: 此提交实现处理参与现有事务和程序化回滚请求。委托给isRollbackOnly、doCommit和rollback。

items.source: Set whether doRollback should be performed on failure of the doCommit call.
items.translation: 设置是否在doCommit调用失败时执行doRollback。

items.source: Actually invoke the afterCompletion methods of the given Spring TransactionSynchronization objects.
items.translation: 实际上调用给定 Spring 事务同步对象的afterCompletion方法。

items.source: Make preparations for commit, to be performed before the beforeCommit synchronization callbacks occur.
items.translation: 准备提交，在发生 beforeCommit 同步回调之前执行。

items.source: Return whether to call doCommit on a transaction that has been marked as rollback-only in a global fashion.
items.translation: 返回是否对已在全局范围内标记为仅回滚的事务调用 `doCommit`。

items.source: Holder for suspended resources.
items.translation: 挂起资源的持有者。

items.source:
This implementation of commit handles participating in existing
transactions and programmatic rollback requests.
items.translation: 该提交实现支持参与现有事务以及程序化回滚请求。

items.source: Determine the actual timeout to use for the given definition.

items.source:
Begin a new transaction with semantics according to the given transaction
definition.
items.translation: 根据给定的事务定义，开始一个新的事务。

items.source: Cleanup resources after transaction completion.
items.translation: 事务完成后清理资源。

items.source: Perform an actual commit of the given transaction.
items.translation: 提交给定事务的实际提交。

items.source: Return a transaction object for the current transaction state.
items.translation: 返回当前事务状态的 Transaction 对象。

items.source: Resume the resources of the current transaction.
items.translation: 恢复当前事务的资源。

items.source: Perform an actual rollback of the given transaction.
items.translation: 执行给定事务的实际回滚。

items.source: Set the given transaction rollback-only.
items.translation: 将给定的事务设置为仅回滚。

items.source: Suspend the resources of the current transaction.
items.translation: 挂起当前事务的资源。

items.source:
Return the default timeout that this transaction manager should apply
if there is no timeout specified at the transaction level, in seconds.
items.translation: 返回此事务管理器在事务级别未指定超时时应应用的默认超时时间，单位为秒。

items.source: This implementation handles propagation behavior.
items.translation: 此实现处理传播行为。

items.source:
Check if the given transaction object indicates an existing transaction
(that is, a transaction which has already started).
items.translation: 检查给定的事务对象是否表示一个已存在的事务（即，一个已经启动的事务）。

items.source: Register the given list of transaction synchronizations with the existing transaction.
items.translation: 将给定的事务同步列表注册到现有事务中。

items.source: Resume the given transaction.
items.translation: 恢复给定的事务。

items.source:
This implementation of rollback handles participating in existing
transactions.
items.translation: 此回滚实现处理参与现有事务。

items.source:
Specify the default timeout that this transaction manager should apply
if there is no timeout specified at the transaction level, in seconds.
items.translation: 指定此事务管理器在事务级别未指定超时时应应用的默认超时时间，单位为秒。

items.source:
Set whether to fail early in case of the transaction being globally marked
as rollback-only.
items.translation: 设置是否在事务被全局标记为仅回滚时提前失败。

items.source:
Set whether to globally mark an existing transaction as rollback-only
after a participating transaction failed.
items.translation: 设置是否在参与的事务失败后，将现有事务全局标记为仅回滚。

items.source: Set whether nested transactions are allowed.
items.translation: 设置是否允许嵌套事务。

items.source:
Set when this transaction manager should activate the thread-bound
transaction synchronization support.
items.translation: 设置何时此事务管理器应激活线程绑定的事务同步支持。

items.source:
Set whether existing transactions should be validated before participating
in them.
items.translation: 设置是否在参与现有事务之前对其进行验证。

items.source: Suspend the given transaction.
items.translation: 挂起给定的事务。

items.source: Return whether to use a savepoint for a nested transaction.
items.translation: 返回是否对嵌套事务使用保存点。

items.source:
Determine the actual timeout to use for the given definition.
Will fall back to this manager's default timeout if the
transaction definition doesn't specify a non-default value.
items.translation: 确定给定定义要使用的实际超时时间。如果事务定义未指定非默认值，则回退到此管理器的默认超时时间。
